set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense
script=$base/bin/export
source_file=$base/invoices.csv
sentinel=$base/protected.txt
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/invoice-security-test.XXXXXXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f -- "$test_dir/symlink-output.csv"; rmdir -- "$test_dir" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT HUP INT TERM
source_before=$(sha256sum "$source_file" | awk '{print $1}')
sentinel_before=$(sha256sum "$sentinel" | awk '{print $1}')
old_temp=$base/tmp/export.tmp

sentinel_after=$(sha256sum "$sentinel" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$source_before" = "$source_after"
test "$sentinel_before" = "$sentinel_after"
printf 'source_sha256_before=%s source_sha256_after=%s rows=%s\n' "$source_before" "$source_after" "$(wc -l < "$source_file")"
printf 'sentinel_sha256_before=%s sentinel_sha256_after=%s\n' "$sentinel_before" "$sentinel_after"
printf 'output_type=%s output_mode=%s output_matches_source=yes\n' "$(stat -c %F "$test_dir/symlink-output.csv")" "$(stat -c %a "$test_dir/symlink-output.csv")"

    rm -f -- "$old_temp"
else
    printf '%s\n' 'unexpected legacy temp state; refusing cleanup' >&2

fi
test -z "$(find "$base/tmp" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)"
printf 'legacy_tmp_empty=yes\n'

rmdir -- "$test_dir"
